talks.title: From a 2.8 GPA to Leading AI Platform Development at Scale
talks.abstract: In a world that rewards perfect curation, by both humans and AI, it's easy to believe a successful career in tech means landing every move with a perfect 10. The engineers who thrive are the ones who run toward challenges and welcome failure as a close friend. Kylie shares twelve years of that, from graduating UCSD with a 2.8 GPA to leading AI platform development at scale at Intuit.

speakers.name: Kylie Taitano
speakers.role: Manager, Software Engineering · Intuit · UCSD BS in Computer Science '14
speakers.bio: Kylie serves on the UC San Diego CSE Alumni Advisory Board. She spent nine years as a software engineer at Intuit before becoming a manager, and now leads the TurboTax Online platform teams behind the backend services and AI capabilities that serve tens of millions of customers a year. She also co-founded Code With Her, a San Diego nonprofit that has brought coding workshops and mentorship to thousands of students from underrepresented communities. When she's not championing tech and culture, you can usually find her chasing sunsets (and her two dogs, Bo and Butter) at Fiesta Island Dog Beach.

talks.title: Panel: UC San Diego Student Interns, Summer 2026
AI, Games, and Software Engineering: Inside XBOX
talks.abstract: Drawing on my work at XBOX, this talk looks at how AI is changing the way engineers prototype, explore codebases, and increasingly work with agents — and at how it's reshaping game development, from tooling to creative process. I'll share where AI meaningfully amplifies engineers, where it falls short, and why technical judgment still matters.

speakers.name: Roy Guo
speakers.bio: Roy Guo is a senior software engineer at Microsoft working on XBOX shopping experiences across web, PC, and console. A UC San Diego and UC Berkeley computer science graduate, he has worked across full-stack development, cloud infrastructure, and game technology. Today, his work focuses on applying AI to software engineering and building consumer experiences at XBOX.
